name: Noodle Seed OG social card by Noodle Seed
description: A 1200×630 social card on a near-black canvas, with a dramatic plume of orange-to-red light streaks curving up from the bottom edges like wings, framing a fully centered text block. Hierarchy is strict: small wordmark with a leaf/seed glyph, then a two-line headline in large white rounded sans, then a two-line muted gray subhead. The dark void in the middle gives the copy total legibility while the warm swirls supply all the colour and energy.
